description: The chart illustrates the popularity of different categories across three domains: Movies, Songs, and Basketball, for two models, Llama3 and ChatGPT. The categories are represented on the horizontal axis, labeled with the three domains, while the vertical axis represents the popularity, ranging from 20 to 220 with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of 20, 60, 100, 140, 180, and 220. Each domain has a grouped set of bars, with three bars for each model, distinguished by different patterns and colors: Acc=0 & GT Ans (dotted), Acc=0 & Gene Ans (diagonal lines), and Acc=1 & GT Ans (solid). For Llama3, the bars are blue, and for ChatGPT, they are red, with corresponding yellow bars for the Acc values. The bars are not sorted in a specific order within each group. The popularity values for Movies range from approximately 25 to 40, for Songs from around 40 to 70, and for Basketball from about 100 to 200. The tallest bars are observed in the Basketball category, with values reaching up to 180 for ChatGPT with Acc=0 & Gene Ans, while the shortest bars are in the Movies category, with values around 25-30 for both models with Acc=1 & GT Ans.
